questions.question: input() kya return karta hai?
questions.answer: input() hamesha string return karta hai, chahe user number type kare. Number chahiye to int() ya float() use karo.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: sep aur end kya hain?
questions.answer: sep multiple print values ke beech separator control karta hai. end line ke end ka text control karta hai; default newline hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: f-string kyun use karte hain?
questions.answer: Variables aur expressions ko readable tarike se string me embed karne ke liye. Ye modern aur concise hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: split() + map() ka common use?
questions.answer: Ek line ke space-separated inputs ko todkar har item ko same type me convert karna, jaise map(int, input().split()).
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: f-string me :.2f kya karega?
questions.answer: Number ko 2 decimal places tak format karega.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: print(*list) kya karta hai?
questions.answer: List ke items ko unpack karke alag arguments ki tarah print karta hai.
